own_solution.law: Snell's law gives sin(theta)=sin(40 degrees)/1.8. Specular side reflections preserve the axial velocity component, so t=nL/(c cos(theta)).
assumptions: The end faces are perpendicular to the rod axis.
The glass is uniform, with pulse speed c/1.8 because it is nondispersive.
The refractive index of air is approximately 1.

T51AF.regime: Total internal reflection persists when the surrounding index is less than n cos(theta)=1.68132; 1.37 satisfies this condition.

TD2A3.regime: Total internal reflection persists when the surrounding index is less than 1.68132; 1.37 satisfies this condition.

defect_reasons.missing_assumption: T2524 and TB902 introduce an additional glass coupler without specifying its refractive index or establishing that it forms a straight extension with the same optical properties as the rod, so the additional transit time is not determined.
defect_reasons.rendering_not_minimal: T97AD and TACC7 replace the explicit 1.3 m in corresponding length variants with the unquantified phrase 'a little', violating the requirement that variants preserve the same stated number and unit.

counterexamples.description: For a straight, aligned 1.3 m extension with perpendicular interfaces, a coupler index of 1.8 gives a total transit time of 21.1977 ns, whereas a coupler index of 1.5 gives approximately 20.04 ns. Both couplers can be nondispersive glass and support total internal reflection.

notes: The base problem has the unique ray-optics answer 12.8471 ns. If the added coupler is explicitly assumed to be a straight continuation of the same n=1.8 glass, T2524 and TB902 instead give 21.1977 ns for total length 3.3 m; their null answers indicate that this assumption is currently missing. Diameter changes transverse distances between reflections and the number of traversals, but cancels from the total path length L/cos(theta), including the final partial traversal. Historical modifications explicitly restricted to an earlier run do not affect the present rod. The two coating sentences preserve the same index, and the two diameter sentences preserve the same diameter. No information outside the supplied packet was accessed.
